8326f4709d401dfabfa78302fb1cdea0f18048a4.definition: Hệ thống ký tự dùng để ghi toán học một cách chính xác.
The agreed way of writing symbols.
8326f4709d401dfabfa78302fb1cdea0f18048a4.gloss: The agreed way of writing symbols.

8326f4709d401dfabfa78302fb1cdea0f18048a4.text: Use precise notation: y = mx + b.
8326f4709d401dfabfa78302fb1cdea0f18048a4.translation: Dùng ký hiệu chính xác: y = mx + b.

8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.definition: The ability you have to do something, whatever you decide to do it for.
8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.gloss: The ability you have to do something, whatever you decide to do it for.

8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.definition: 何かをする能力のこと。何をdecidedするか、何のためにするかによらず、実行できる力をいう。
8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.gloss: 何かをする能力。目的がどんなものであっても、如何にできるか。

8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.definition: 어떤 행동을 할 수 있는 능력이나 여유를 가리킨다. 그것을 실제로 하거나 사용하려는 뜻은 아니며, 순수히 가능한 힘에 초점을 둔다.
8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.gloss: 무엇을 목적과 관계없이 할 수 있는 능력.

8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.definition: A capacidade ou o limite do que uma pessoa é capaz de fazer. Também pode indicar o número de pessoas ou coisas que um local ou recurso comporta.
8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.gloss: A habilidade de fazer algo, independentemente do propósito escolhido.

8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.definition: Kemampuan yang dimiliki seseorang untuk melakukan suatu hal, apa pun tujuan yang dipilih. Istilah ini emphasizing kemampuan, bukan kewajiban atau kesempatan.
ความสามารถที่มีอยู่ในการทำสิ่งหนึ่ง โดยไม่คำนึงว่าจะใช้ความสามารถนั้นเพื่ออะไร
8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.gloss: ความสามารถในการทำสิ่งใดสิ่งหนึ่ง

8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.definition: Bir şeyi yapmak için sahip olunan yetenek veya güç; bu yetenek, eylemin hangi amaçla yapılacağından bağımsızdır.

8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.translation: Yüzünü iyi okuma yeteneği vardı, ama asıl mesele bu yeteneğin var olup olmadığı değildi.
เขามีความสามารถในการอ่านความรู้สึกของผู้อื่นได้ดี และประเด็นนี้ไม่เคยเป็นข้อจำกัดของเขา
Ia mampu membaca ekspresi wajah dengan baik, dan kemampuan itu memang tidak pernah menjadi masalah.
Ele tinha a capacidade de ler bem a expressão de alguém, e essa nunca foi a questão.
그는 사람의 표정을 잘 읽는 능력이 있었고, 그 능력이 문제가 된 적은 없었다.
彼の就读能力は優れていて、問題は能力不足ではなかった。

8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.text: He had the capacity to read a face well, and the capacity was never the question.
8346fc2a8e7a6f027e4f0802d8aa5747b3916f0e.translation: Anh có khả năng đọc được nét mặt, và khả năng ấy chưa bao giờ là vấn đề.

8367cd66fdd136bba8ba23f8805bb050dd628940.definition: Bề mặt bo góc chứa nội dung, ví dụ thẻ gọn ý.
A panel with rounded corners that holds content.
8367cd66fdd136bba8ba23f8805bb050dd628940.gloss: A rounded panel that holds content, such as a callout.

83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.definition: Holding a feeling down so that nothing of it shows to the other person.
83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.gloss: Holding a feeling down so that nothing of it shows to the other person.

83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.definition: 怒りや悲しみなどの感情を内側に押し込め、何も見せないことをいう。平静を装うことに过你…。
83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.gloss: 感情を押さえ込み、相手にも周囲にも見せないこと。

83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.definition: 감정을 안고 누르거나 감정을 보이지 않게 해서 상대가 알아채지 못하게 하는 것이다. 겉으로 차분해 보여도 내부의 감정이나 긴장이 완전히 사라진 것은 아니며, 평정함으로 오해받을 수 있다.
83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.gloss: 감정을 억눌러 상대에게 아무것도 드러내지 않는 것.

83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.definition: A tentativa de conter um sentimento para que nenhuma parte dele seja perceptível pelo outro. A calma aparente pode, portanto, ser interpretada como indiferença.
83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.gloss: Manter um sentimento abaixo da superfície, sem deixá-lo aparecer diante da outra pessoa.

83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.definition: Tindakan menahan atau menyembunyikan perasaan sehingga orang lain tidak melihatnya. Penekanan ini dapat membuat ketenangan tampak seperti ketidakpedulian.
83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.gloss: Penekanan emosi agar tidak tampak oleh orang lain.

83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.definition: การควบคุมหรือระงับความรู้สึกภายในจนไม่เปิดเผยให้อีกฝ่ายเห็น ซึ่งอาจดูคล้ายเป็นความสงบแต่ไม่จำเป็นต้องเป็นความสงบจริง
83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.gloss: การกดความรู้สึกไว้จนไม่แสดงออก

83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.definition: Bir duyguyu bastırarak davranışsal, sözlü veya bedensel hiçbir iz vermemek. Dışarıdan görünen sakinlik, duygunun yokluğunu göstermez.
83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.gloss: Duyguyu içeride tutarak karşıdakine hiçbir belirti göstermemek.

83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.translation: Duygusunu bastırması sakinlik gibi görünüyordu; bu sakinlik de ilgisizlik olarak yorumlandı.
การกดความรู้สึกของเธอดูเหมือนความสงบ และความสงบนั้นถูกมองเป็นความไม่แยแส
Penekanan emosinya tampak seperti ketenangan, dan ketenangan itu dibaca sebagai ketidakpedulian.
A supressão parecia calma, e a calma foi interpretada como indiferença.
그녀의 감정 억제는 차분해 보였고, 그 차분함은 무관심함으로 읽혔다.
彼女の抑制は平静に見え、その平静は無関心だと解釈された。

83b27bf85945230d7856f77da4eb94a3319ad822.text: Her suppression looked like calm, and the calm was read as indifference.

83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.definition: The transition before menopause, when the cycles often change.
83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.gloss: The transition before menopause, when the cycles often change.

83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.definition: 更年期に先行して、排卵や月経周期の規則性が変わり始める過渡的な段階を指す。更年期そのものではない。
83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.gloss: 更年期に入る前の过渡期で、月経周期などが変化し始める時期。

83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.definition: 월경 주기의 길이나 출혈양이 달라지면서 갱년기로 이어지는 시기를 가리킨다. 갱년기 이후의 상태와 구별된다.
83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.gloss: 갱년기에 이르기 전 월경 주기가 변하기 시작하는 전환기.

83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.definition: Perimenopause adalah periode peralihan menuju menopause yang dapat lasted?
83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.gloss: Masa peralihan sebelum menopause ketika siklus menstruasi sering berubah.

83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.definition: ระยะเวลาก่อนการหมดประจำเดือนที่สมดุลของฮอร์โมนเริ่มเปลี่ยนแปลง รอบประจำเดือนอาจยาว สั้น หรือผันผวน แต่ไม่ได้เปลี่ยนทุกคนในทิศทางเดียวกัน
83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.gloss: ช่วงเปลี่ยนผ่านก่อนการหมดประจำเดือน

83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.definition: Perimenopoz, menopozdan önceki geçiş dönemidir ve bu süreçte adet döngüleri düzensizleşebilir. Döngülerin değişmesi, menopozun yaklaştığının göstergelerinden biridir.
83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.gloss: Menopozdan önceki, adet döngülerinin sık sık değişmeye başladığı geçiş dönemi.

83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.definition: Fase de transição que antecede a menopausa, caracterizada por alterações na duração e no padrão dos ciclos menstruais. Pode durar vários anos e não significa que a menstruação tenha cessado completamente.
83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.gloss: Período de transição anterior à menopausa, em que os ciclos menstruais often mudam.

83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.translation: Ela estava na perimenopausa e apresentava alterações nos ciclos menstruais havia algum tempo.
Perimenopozdaydı ve adet döngüleri bir süredir değişmişti.
ระหว่างช่วงเปลี่ยนผ่านก่อนหมดประจำเดือน เธอมีประจำเดือนที่ผันผวนเป็นระยะ
Ia sedang dalam perimenopause, dan siklus menstruasinya telah berubah selama beberapa waktu.
갱년기 전 단계에서 월경 주기가 불규칙해졌다.
彼女は前更年期に入り、数か月前から月経周期が変わっていた。

83f864e8baf98ccb70236adc66348805cf0c63b3.text: She was in perimenopause, and her cycles had changed for a while.
